Why the split matters. The amount cipher is additive, and its mask depends on the salt. Reuse a predictable
salt on two notes holding different amounts and anyone can subtract the ciphertexts and read the difference.
Zero-amount notes have nothing to leak. Rust encodes this as separate types, so mixing them will not compile.
